rule: A technical pass or changed image hash is not a quality promotion. Promotion requires retained provenance plus real visual/engine evidence when the decision is visual.

decisions.subject: hm08_head_seed
decisions.reason: v0.1 was structurally valid but real silhouette inspection exposed artificial scalp/side crop holes. v0.2 changed extraction to a metadata vertical slab plus largest connected body surface and reduced boundary edges from 374 to 58.

decisions.subject: eye_placement
decisions.reason: Godot front/three-quarter/profile views showed the generated eyes seating correctly in the eyelids without hand-fit offsets.

decisions.subject: skin_semantic_v0.1
decisions.reason: Visual delta was too small and the first mouth landmark was later proven wrong because a crop boundary was misidentified as the mouth. Keep history for learning; do not use as preferred skin state.

decisions.subject: secondary_facial_forms_v0.1
decisions.reason: Twelve reversible AXM-native targets passed topology/symmetry/displacement gates and Godot import, but their default combined visual effect was too subtle to call an improvement under the current close-view lab.
decisions.authority: native displacement receipts + real Godot A/B

decisions.subject: skin_authoring
decisions.reason: The generic UV-space skin produced atlas-scale blotches/pore response in close Godot views. physical_v0.1 evaluates authored variation in canonical 3D hm08 space before rasterizing to the preserved UV atlas, visibly removing the large blotches while retaining deterministic local PBR state.
decisions.authority: real Godot front/three-quarter/profile A/B + preserved skin maps
limits: no real subsurface engine model yet

truth: These are current Run 2 promotion decisions, not permanent canon. Later evidence may supersede them through an explicit new decision record.
